capabilities: search TMDb for film artists as you type
create structured artist notes in a configured folder
replace note content with a rendered TMDb template
download profile images into the vault
extras: The 'Insert film artist metadata' command replaces the entire content of the current note, which the README flags with a warning. API key is stored in Obsidian's built-in Secret storage. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up film industry people (actors, directors, writers) on TMDb and turn them into note content or links.

requires.name: TMDb account (free, to obtain the API key)

summary: TMDb search plugin that creates structured notes for film artists, inserts wikilinks, or fills the current note from a rendered template.
